name: LLM Judge Smoke Suite
description: Demonstrates LLM-as-judge grading. Requires a ModelClient to be available (use --provider and --model flags).

tasks.title: FizzBuzz implementation judged by LLM
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function fizzbuzz(n) that prints numbers 1 to n, replacing multiples of 3 with 'Fizz', multiples of 5 with 'Buzz', and multiples of both with 'FizzBuzz'.

config.criteria: Function is named fizzbuzz. Takes one integer parameter n. Prints numbers 1 to n. Multiples of 3 print 'Fizz'. Multiples of 5 print 'Buzz'. Multiples of both print 'FizzBuzz'. Code is valid Python.
